xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfCyberSecurityInc: Infosys was notified by its vendor, ESOP Direct (Qapita)—engaged to host and manage the employee stock incentive program for eligible employees of the Company and its subsidiaries—of a cybersecurity incident that potentially involved a compromise of employee data. At the time of notification, the vendor indicated that records of 2,138 unique individuals (past and present employees) were exposed. Subsequently the vendor has notified the increase in number to 2,463. Infosys has taken its own actions and notified the relevant regulators in affected jurisdictions, insurers, and informed impacted individuals. There is no material impact on the Company.

Infosys invests in AI driven start-up platform Aerchain as part of Infosys Innovation Fund
Enterprises are unlocking AI value to build smarter sourcing & procurement function. Infosys is at the forefront, bringing AI-powered deeptech solutions to forward-thinking organizations across industries to create a more resilient, informed, and strategic capabilities that gives global corporations an edge in the market. Infosys Innovation Fund invests in AI-driven start-up platform Aerchain (https://aerchain.io/), based in Bengaluru, bringing the power of Infosys ecosystem and co-create next-generation solutions making sourcing seamless, data-driven, and future ready. Infosys will transform organizations to accelerate AI-powered value creation and redefine procurement excellence, together with Aerchain.
